Specification: This module is a model-checking wrapper around an underlying abstraction module, restricting the server set, term range, and log bounds to make exploration finite. It defines a concrete symmetric server set of three nodes, bounds terms to 2..4, sets the start term to the minimum of that range, and constrains log lengths via bounded sequences and an explicit length constraint. The file does not define a full temporal specification itself; instead it provides configuration-style helper operators and type constraints intended to be used with the imported abstraction, with symmetry reduction through permutations of the server set.
